title: Vegetable and Chickpea Soup
subtitle: with turmeric, coriander and parsley
description: A hearty vegetable soup with chickpeas, potato, pumpkin and zucchini, gently seasoned with turmeric and black pepper. Only 10 minutes of prep.

steps.text: Roughly chop the onions, thinly slice the celery, slice the carrots, cube the potatoes, zucchini and pumpkin, and chop the coriander and parsley.
Fry the onion, celery and chickpeas over high heat for about 5 minutes. Add the carrot and potato and keep frying, stirring, for about 2 minutes.
Add water to cover the ingredients and bring to the boil.
Add the zucchini and pumpkin and bring to the boil again.
Reduce the heat and add the coriander and parsley. Stir for about 2 minutes and season with the salt, pepper and turmeric.
Cook covered at a gentle simmer until the potatoes are tender.
